title: Free Ebooks Library
subtitle: Classic texts, freely shared
meta_description: Free ebooks on Arunachala and the teachings of Sri Ramana Maharshi — Conscious Immortality, The Glory of Arunachala, The Essence of the Ribhu Gita, and more, freely downloadable.
body_html:
Free downloadable ebooks on Arunachala, Ramana Maharshi, and the path of self-enquiry.

Disclaimer: the e-books offered here have been gathered from sources that already make them freely accessible. We neither charge for nor derive revenue from their distribution; full copyright remains with the original authors and publishers. If you hold rights to a work hosted here and would prefer it removed or credited differently, please write to info@arunachalasamudra.co.in and we will respond promptly.

Available now

  • Conscious Immortality — Paul Brunton's notebook of conversations with Sri Ramana Maharshi, recorded in the 1930s. One of the most intimate records of Bhagavan's presence. Download free (Archive.org) →
  • Maharishi and His Message — Paul Brunton's chapters from A Search in Secret India — the book that first brought Ramana Maharshi to the attention of the Western world.
  • The Glory of Arunachala — A classic account of the sacred hill, its legends, and its place in the heart of devotees.
  • The Essence of the Ribhu Gita — Selected verses from the Ribhu Gita, a text Ramana Maharshi held in the highest regard for direct non-dual instruction.
notes: Added Conscious Immortality (Paul Brunton) July 2026. Updated disclaimer email to .co.in domain.
